variety: Classical/Central Nahuatl (16th-c. central Mexico) as recorded in Molina 1571 and glossed in Karttunen 1983, matching src/content/cards.json; a few entries attested only in modern varieties cited by Karttunen (T = Tetelcingo, Z = Zacapoaxtla) or in GDN (Mecayapan) are marked as such. Modern community variety to be chosen with reviewers.
orthography: Classical practical orthography as in cards.json: tz, tl, ch, x=/ʃ/, hu-/-uh for /w/, cu/qu for /kʷ/ and /k/, c/z for /s/; no vowel-length or saltillo marks (hence ayotli 'squash' vs ayotl 'turtle'). Molina's u/v/y spellings normalized (quauitl → cuahuitl). Spanish loans keep Spanish spelling.

perro.source: ond s.v. itzcuintli; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.108 ITZCUĪN-TLI 'perro, perra'
perro.note: Classical general word for dog. Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant. Many modern varieties use chichi; reviewer may prefer it.
perro.reviewQuestion: ¿Para el perro dicen 'itzcuintli' o 'chichi' en su comunidad?

pez.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.56r 'michin. pescado'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.146
pez.reviewQuestion: ¿'Michin' es la palabra común para pez/pescado?

venado.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.50r 'mazatl. venado'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.142
venado.note: Early colonial texts also used it for 'horse'; Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant.

mono.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 128043 'oçumatli: mona animal conocido'; ond s.v. ozomatli
mono.note: Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant.
mono.reviewQuestion: ¿'Ozomatli' es la palabra común para mono?

murcielago.note: Chosen over tzinacan (Molina f.152r 'murciélago que muerde'), which is also linked to the bat deity/place names. Shares the root quimich- with raton (quimichin): spelling-choice confusion risk.
murcielago.reviewQuestion: ¿Usan 'quimichpatlan' o 'tzinacan' para el murciélago? ¿Alguna asociación negativa?

hormiga.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.10r 'azcatl. hormiga'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.17
hormiga.note: Root shared with hormiguero (azcaxalli); distinct strings.
hormiga.reviewQuestion: ¿'Azcatl' es la palabra común para hormiga?

abeja.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.82r 'pipiyolin. aueja montesa'; ond s.v. pipiyolin (Florentine Codex Bk 11 f.99v)
abeja.note: Native stingless bee, matching the card. Alternative xicotli = large bee/bumblebee (Molina f.159r).

arana.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.148r 'tocatl. araña generalmente'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.242
arana.reviewQuestion: ¿'Tocatl' es la palabra común para araña?

caracol.note: No clear Classical word for a LAND snail found. tecciztli (Molina f.92r) is the conch trumpet (excluded by card rules); cuechtli = long spiral shell (f.25v); Molina pt.1 also lists 'vilacatochi: caracol' (gdn pk 144601), unverified. Needs reviewer.
caracol.reviewQuestion: ¿Cómo se dice el caracol de tierra (el que sale con la lluvia) en su variante?

cangrejo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.93v 'tecuicitli. cangrejo'; also f.7v 'atecuicitli. cangrejo'

armadillo.source: ond s.v. ayotochtli; gdn Clavijero-era entry 'Ayotochtli: armadillo' (pk 178524); modern ayotochin (Tzinacapan)
armadillo.note: Contains ayo- like tortuga (ayotl): visual/spelling confusion is low.

lagartija.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 112358 'cuetzpalin: lagartija'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.71
lagartija.note: Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant.
lagartija.reviewQuestion: ¿'Cuetzpalin' es la palabra común para lagartija?

perico.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.23r 'cocho. papagayo'; molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 143387 'toznene: papagayo, aue conocida cocho'
perico.note: toznene = talking parrot (yellow-headed amazon); alo = macaw; quiliton = small parrot (Molina pt.1).
perico.reviewQuestion: ¿Para el perico verde dicen 'cocho', 'toznene' u otra palabra?

raton.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.90r 'quimichin. raton'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.211
raton.reviewQuestion: ¿'Quimichin' es la palabra común para ratón?

gallina.source: karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.60 CUĀNACA 'gallo o gallina de castilla (M)'; Florentine Codex cited there
gallina.note: Post-contact coinage attested in 16th-c. sources. Alternative caxtil (Molina f.13r 'gallo, o gallina de castilla'). NOT totolin/huexolotl (turkey).

arbol.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 129385 'quauitl: arbol generalmente, palo o madero'; ond s.v. cuahuitl
arbol.note: Also 'wood/stick'; reserve 'lena' uses tlatlatilcuahuitl to avoid a collision.

hoja.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.49v 'izuatl. hoja'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.123
hoja.note: Karttunen notes it is usually possessed; also used for maize husk/tamale leaf. xihuitl ('grass, herb, year, turquoise') avoided.
hoja.reviewQuestion: ¿Una hoja de árbol suelta se dice 'izhuatl'?

flor.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.160r 'xochitl. rosa, o flor'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.329
flor.note: Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant. Root also in girasol (chimalxochitl).

cacahuate.source: karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.273 TLĀLCACAHUA-TL 'cacahuate' (T,Z); gdn modern entries 'tlalcacahua' (Mecayapan), 'tälkakauat'
cacahuate.note: Attested in modern varieties cited by Karttunen, not in Molina.

raiz.source: karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.163 NELHUA-TL 'raíz' (T); cf. molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 116603 'nelhuayotl: rayz de arbol o yerua'
raiz.note: Molina's form is nelhuayotl (also 'origin, foundation'); nelhuatl is the modern-attested free noun.

calabaza.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.3v 'ayotli. calabaza'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.16
calabaza.note: COLLISION RISK: differs by one letter from tortuga 'ayotl' (turtle) in this orthography (ayohtli vs ayotl with saltillo/length). Strong spelling-choice confusion.

yuca.source: karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.71 CUAUHCAMOH-TLI 'yuca' (T,Z); gdn 'cuajcamoj: yuca' (Mecayapan)

camote.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.12r 'camotli. batata, rayz comestible'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.24

algodon.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.32r 'ichcatl. algodon, o oueja'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.92
algodon.note: Colonial extension 'sheep'; card shows the cotton boll.

huevo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.150v 'totoltetl. hueuo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.248

hongo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.62v 'nanacatl. hongo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.159
hongo.note: SACRED DOUBLE: teonanacatl = ritual mushrooms. Plain nanacatl is the everyday edible mushroom; art must show a plain edible cap.
hongo.reviewQuestion: ¿'Nanacatl' se usa para hongos comestibles sin connotación ritual?

platano.source: ond s.v. plátano (Anales de Juan Bautista, ca. 1582, ed. Reyes García 2001, pp.168-169: 'Platanos'); Arenas vocabulario 'polatanox'
platano.note: Loan attested in colonial Nahuatl writing. Modern forms vary (gdn: 'pajpata/papatla' Tzinacapan, 'tzapo' Mecayapan).
platano.reviewQuestion: ¿Cómo dicen 'plátano' en su variante: 'plátano', 'papatla' u otra?

pasto.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.13v 'zacatl. paja'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.345 (pasto, zacate)

papaya.source: gdn, Mecayapan dictionary entry 'papaya: papaya' (pk 26526); 'ocotena: papaya de monte' (pk 26477)
papaya.note: No Classical word found in Molina/Karttunen/ONDict. Only a modern Isthmus Nahuat (Mecayapan) loan; different variety.
papaya.reviewQuestion: ¿Hay palabra náhuatl para papaya, o se dice 'papaya'?

fuego.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.147v 'tletl. fuego'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.308

humo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.83r 'poctli. humo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.200
humo.note: Root of popoca in existing 'citlalin popoca' (cometa) and 'popocani tepetl' (volcan).

neblina.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.3r 'ayauitl. niebla, neblina'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.16

granizo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.92v 'teciuitl. granizo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.216

nieve.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.18r 'cepayauitl. nieue'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.); Sahagún Primeros Memoriales p.157

hielo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.18v 'cetl. yelo, o carambano'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.33

amanecer.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.145r 'tlauizcalli. el alua'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.270
amanecer.note: Root of the deity name Tlahuizcalpantecuhtli (Venus); the plain noun is ordinary.
amanecer.reviewQuestion: ¿'Tlahuizcalli' se usa para el amanecer sin sentido religioso?

noche.note: Yohualli ehecatl is a deity epithet (Sahagún); the plain noun is everyday.

cielo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.37v 'Ilhuicatl. cielo'; ond s.v. ilhuicatl
cielo.note: Cosmological 'heaven' sense; existing mar is 'ilhuicaatl' (sky-water): spelling-choice confusion risk.

sombra.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.18v 'ceualli. sombra de alguna cosa'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.28

rocio.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 109213 'auachtli: rocio'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.5

remolino.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.28r 'ecamalacotl. remolino de viento'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.75
remolino.note: Contains ehecatl (viento card; also deity name).

agua.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.8r 'Atl. agua'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
agua.note: Also a tonalpohualli day sign; the everyday animal/thing noun is meant. Very short; root of many cards (atoyatl, atezcatl...).

ceniza.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.71v 'nextli. ceniza'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.171

trueno.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.139v 'tlatlatziniliztli. trueno de rayo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.299
trueno.note: Nominalization of tlatlatzini 'to thunder'; long word.
trueno.reviewQuestion: ¿'Tlatlatziniliztli' para trueno, o usan otra palabra?

rio.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 109167 'atoyatl: rio'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.14

lago.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 144414 'vey atezcatl: lago de agua' / 144415 'laguna'
lago.note: Two words. COLLISION: contains charco 'atezcatl'. Alternative amanalli (Molina f.4v 'alberca o estanque'; K p.10 'lake').

piedra.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.107v 'tetl. piedra, generalmente'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)

arena.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.158v 'xalli. arena'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.321

playa.gloss: shore, bank of river or sea
playa.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.7v 'atentli. ribera de rio o de mar'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.13
playa.note: Shore/bank generally, not specifically a sandy beach.
playa.reviewQuestion: ¿'Atentli' sirve para playa, o hay otra palabra?

cascada.source: Searched Molina pt.1 via gdn ('cascada', 'salto de agua'), ONDict; no entry
cascada.note: Closest: 'atl ichololiz' = chorro de agua (Molina pt.1 pk 108634), not a waterfall. Not used: would be substitution.
cascada.reviewQuestion: ¿Cómo se dice cascada / caída de agua en su variante?

charco.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.7v 'atezcatl. charco de agua'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.13
charco.note: See lago collision. Alternative 'atl momana' (Molina pt.1 'charco').

lodo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.25r 'zoquitl. barro, o lodo'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
lodo.note: Formulaic for 'body' in Christian testaments; plain sense is everyday.

barranca.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.8v 'atlauhtli. barranca grande'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.14

llano.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.48v 'ixtlauatl. vega o tierra llana, zauana'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.121

pantano.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.25r 'zoquiatl. cieno'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.349 'marsh, pool'
pantano.note: Molina gloss is 'silt/mire'; Karttunen gives 'marsh'. Shares root with lodo (zoquitl).

ola.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.3r 'acueyotl. ola. vel. onda de agua'

concha.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.9r 'atzcalli. ostia dela mar'
concha.note: Bivalve/clam shell; not the conch trumpet (tecciztli).

valle.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.102v 'tepetzalan. quebrada de monte, o entre sierras'; molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 132681 'valle'

tierra.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.124r 'tlalli. tierra, o heredad'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
tierra.note: Plain soil sense; not the deity (Tlaltecuhtli).

hacha.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 128670 'q[ua]uhtlateconi: hacha para cortar leña'
hacha.note: Instrument noun. tepoztli (Molina f.104v 'cobre o hierro') also used for axes but means 'metal'. Also tlaximaltepoztli 'hacha para labrar madera'.

red.source: karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.139 MĀTL(A)-TL 'red generalmente (M)'; molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 114186 'michmatlatl: red para peces'
red.reviewQuestion: ¿'Matlatl' o 'michmatlatl' para la red de pescar?

cuerda.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.55r 'mecatl. cordel, o soga'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
cuerda.note: Also 'lash' and (possessed) 'concubine'; source of Spanish mecate.

jicara.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.158v 'xicalli. vaso de calabaza'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.323

metate.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.55v 'metlatl. piedra donde muelen el mayz'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.143

comal.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.24r 'Comalli. comal'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.41

escoba.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 128565 'popotl: escoba para barrer'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.203

aguja.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 141506 'tlatzomaloni: aguja para coser'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) TLAHTZOMALŌNI 'aguja' (Z)

huso.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.51v 'malacatl. huso'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.134
huso.note: Gendered (women's work) association in sources; object drawn alone.

banco.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.33v 'icpalli. assentadero'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
banco.note: SENSITIVITY: icpalli is also the seat of authority/throne and metaphor for rulership. Check plain-stool reading.
banco.reviewQuestion: ¿'Icpalli' se entiende como banquito común o como trono?

sombrero.note: Long colonial term; Molina pt.1 also lists 'sombrero' as a loan.

morral.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.159r 'xiquipilli. costal, talega, alforja, o bolsa'
morral.note: Also the number 8,000. Alt. matlaxiquipilli 'talega de red'; itacatl 'mochila' (= provisions).
morral.reviewQuestion: ¿'Xiquipilli' para morral, o usan otra palabra?

hamaca.source: Not in Molina pt.1/2, Karttunen or ONDict (searched); gdn Mecayapan only 'ijama: hamaca (su)'
hamaca.note: Only a possessed form in Isthmus Nahuat (likely from Spanish hamaca); unpossessed form not attested. Not Classical.
hamaca.reviewQuestion: ¿Cómo se dice hamaca en su variante?

coa.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.157v 'uictli. coa'; Lockhart 2001 p.218

petate.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.81r 'petlatl. estera'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.192
petate.note: In 'in petlatl in icpalli' (mat and seat) = authority; plain noun is everyday.

camino.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.78r 'otli. camino'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.177

nido.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.90v 'tapazolli. nido de paxaros'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.214

colmena.note: Also 'honey jar'. Alt. mimiahuatl 'round hive in trees' (Molina pt.1).

telarana.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 142871 'tocatzaualli: telaraña'

patio.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.42v 'ithualli. patio'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)

huerto.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.89v 'quilmilli. huerta de ortaliza'

cerca.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 111557 'chinamitl: seto'; Lockhart 2001 p.214
cerca.note: Also city subunit and chinampa. tepancalli (corral) avoided for collision.

puerta.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.89v 'quiauatl. puerta o entrada'

techo.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.11v 'calquaitl. techo de casa'

escalera.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.28r 'ecauaztli. escalera de palo para alcanzar algo'
escalera.note: Fits the notched-log ladder. tlamamatlatl = stone steps.

troje.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.26v 'cuezcomatl. troxa'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)

cocina.source: molina1571 pt.1 (Sp-Nah) via gdn pk 139683 'tlaqualchiualoyan: cozina donde guisan'

corral.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.101v 'tepancalli. corral'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)
corral.note: Also 'cerca de casa' (Molina pt.1): overlaps with cerca.

gusano.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.76r 'ocuilin. gusano'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.)

pato.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.12r 'canauhtli. pato'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) p.24

collar.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.27v 'cuzcatl. joya... cuenta'; karttunen1983 (1992 repr.) 'collar' (Z)

cuchara.source: molina1571 pt.2 (Nah-Sp) f.161r 'xomatli. cuchara de barro'

lena.note: RESERVE card. cuahuitl alone also = leña but is arbol.
